Natural material textures, believable optics, physically coherent light, realistic skin, anatomy and hands. This is one continuous real scene, not a collage, infographic, illustration, split-screen, panels, toy model or app screenshot. When several targets are requested they must be visually distinct at phone size, well separated left to right, with clear empty space above each target for UI markers added later, and they must never touch or overlap each other. Do not draw dots, arrows, labels, UI, speech bubbles, borders, captions or watermarks. Preserve full people including feet when visible; no cropped heads, hands or action. No padded or blurred side strips. No venue names, logos or answer words; only explicitly requested numerals may appear.

Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 establishes the exact bedroom, its window and its daylight. Create the answer shot of a speaking game in that same bedroom from a closer camera position: the mother (dark ponytail, plain pyjama top) sits up in the bed with both arms stretched upward in a wide waking stretch, eyes just opening, early-morning light coming through the window behind her. Her face and both arms are large and sharp in the central safe area, filling at least 40% of the frame width, and the duvet is still over her legs. This is the moment of waking up. No clock, no phone, no breakfast tray, no other person, no readable words.

cost.basis: Reported usage at uncached list rates; before tax or discounts, not an invoice.

agent_review.notes: Inspected: the mother sits up in the bed with both arms stretched upward and her eyes just opening, early light through the window behind her and the duvet still over her legs; no clock, phone or tray and no other person.
